clips.title: The story
paras: Warsong Saw Blades is a Horde errand undertaken at Splintertree Post on behalf of the Warsong Clan's logging campaign. To acquire heavy saw blades imported from Ratchet, adventurers must strike an under-the-table bargain with the courier Pixel, who demands personal protection before surrendering the shipment. Fulfilling her trade secures essential machinery needed to keep the Horde's lumber mills humming in Ashenvale.

The Warsong loggers in Ashenvale rely entirely on imported heavy machinery to cut through the ancient timber of the deep forest. While Pixel has successfully brought a shipment of specialized saw blades straight from the goblin port of Ratchet to Splintertree Post, she has no intention of simply handing them over for free. Out in the perilous wilds of Ashenvale, coin is only worth so much; personal safety is worth far more. Rather than demanding gold, Pixel insists on bartering the heavy saw blades for a reliable Deadly Blunderbuss to keep herself safe during her dangerous travels through hostile territory.

Ashenvale's dense canopy is prized by the Horde, which faces severe timber shortages across the arid plains of Durotar and the Barrens. However, logging ancient sentinel groves quickly dulls standard axes, making goblin-forged industrial blades a necessity. Securing Pixel's shipment directly fuels the operations of the Warsong lumber camps, ensuring the Horde can continue constructing outposts and war machines despite fierce resistance from the night elves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.
..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!
What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.
So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
